content: Sales leaderboards for small teams: keep it to 1-2 headline KPIs (overcomplicating with weighted scores kills motivational effect). Standard leaderboard columns: deals/activities created, deals closed/won, win rate, sales cycle length. Explicit caution found: for teams under ~5 reps, granular win-rate-style comparisons can create awkwardness/demotivation — worth surfacing as a UX note (not a blocker) even though the milestone explicitly requires this table for a small team.
